name: Back after a day away, Boop is lonely
case: The person locks the Mac and is gone more than a day: 26 hours. When they come back, Boop missed them: its mood turns lonely and it wakes up for them with a lonely face, a small hello, never a cross or sad one.
why: mood/calm.md: lonely when you come back after more than a night away (about 20 hours, not days); the back line gives 26 hours; PERSONALITY's Example: back after 26 hours away is lonely, wake up, says hello, small
